_note: Nat_multitask_convnext_base_v4_2_balsoftmax: Ablation 2 on top of v3_uncalibrated. Isolates soft Balanced Softmax on the disease head (tau=0.5 instead of 1.0 to avoid collapsing seen disease accuracy) while keeping v3's loss weights (0.7/1.3), no CutMix, no drop_path_rate, and gamma_grid=0. Increases early_stopping.min_epochs to 12.

data._note: Standard DPD evaluation on test_seen (2,000) and test_unseen (1,448) across all 333 composition pairs.

model._note: Unchanged from v3: ConvNeXt-Base pretrained on ImageNet-22k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (via timm) with dual linear heads (crop 55, disease 175) and dropout 0.2.

input._note: Standard 256x256 cache with 224x224 center crop for evaluation.

augmentation._note: Unchanged from v3: symptom-preserving crop scale [0.5, 1.0], flips, and gentle color jitter.

loss._note: Keeps v3 weights (crop 0.7 / disease 1.3) and adds soft Balanced Softmax (disease=0.5, crop=0.0) to boost rare diseases without over-penalizing frequent seen diseases.

scheduler._note: Cosine annealing scheduler with 2 warmup epochs decaying to min_lr_ratio 0.01.
scheduler.name: cosine

validation._note: gamma_grid: 0 disables gamma tuning. Stage 1 validation and early stopping evaluate at gamma=0.0 across 3 validation splits.

training._note: min_epochs increased from 5 to 12 to prevent premature stopping.

evaluation._note: Standard DPD benchmark metrics: Top-1, Top-5, per-class means, and Harmonic Mean (HM).

runtime._note: AMP mixed precision on CUDA with 4 workers. Checkpointing every 5 epochs.
